mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FILE ( ref_id, ref_type, original_name, saved_name, file_path, file_size, file_ext, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{refId}, #{refType}, #{originalName}, #{savedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, ref_id, ref_type, original_name, saved_name, file_path, file_size, file_ext, reg_date FROM TB_FILE WHERE ref_id = #{refId} AND ref_type = #{refType} ORDER BY file_id ASC
SELECT file_id, ref_id, ref_type, original_name, saved_name, file_path, file_size, file_ext, reg_date FROM TB_FILE WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
